title: IO Graph: Plot all field instances
description:
Allows to plot all instances of a field in as time series via
"DIRECT(Y Field)".

No aggregation function like SUM, MAX, MIN or others is applied.
The value of the field are plotted directly.

Since all instances of a field are plotted it independant of selected
interval and SMA calculation.

It is limited to numeric fields.

changes_data.diff:
@@ -462,11 +462,18 @@ LOAD(Y Field):::
 If the “Y Field” is a relative time value, this is the sum of the “Y Field” values divided by the interval time.
 This can be useful for tracking response times.
 
+DIRECT(Y Field):::
+Every instance of the specified “Y Field” is shown directly. 
+No intervals are calculated and no aggregation function like MAX, MIN, AVG will be applied.
+Settings for Interval and SMA Period won't have an effect on this graph.
+This mode is usefull for plotting time series of fields. (timestamp as x coordinate and value of the field as y coordinate)
+
 Y Field::
 The display filter field from which to extract values for the Y axis calculations listed above.
 
 SMA Period::
 Show an average of values over a specified period of intervals.
+SMA Period will not affect graphs that are in "DIRECT(Y Field)" mode for Y Axis.
 
 The chart as a whole can be configured using the controls under the graph list:
 
@@ -487,6 +494,7 @@ When using the mouse inside the graph area, either drag the graph contents or se
 
 Interval::
 Set the interval period for the graph.
+Interval will not affect graphs that are in "DIRECT(Y Field)" mode for Y Axis.
 
 Time of day::
 Switch between showing the absolute time of day or the time relative from the start of capture in the X axis.
